    Effect size at the confidence bound nearer the null

    Source: R/statistics-power.R
    cr_conservative_effect.Rd

    Returns the end of a confidence interval that lies closer to zero, which is the conservative effect a follow-up study should be powered on. When the interval spans the null there is nothing to power on and NA is returned.

    Usage

    cr_conservative_effect(ci_low, ci_high)

    Arguments

    ci_low

    Numeric vector of lower interval bounds.

    ci_high

    Numeric vector of upper interval bounds.

    Value

    A numeric vector the length of the recycled inputs.

    See also

    cr_power(), cr_effect_grid().

    Other power: cr_power(), cr_power_analysis(), cr_power_grid()

    Examples

    cr_conservative_effect(c(-1.8, -0.4), c(-0.6, 0.9))
#> [1] -0.6   NA
